name: Lost Connections
source:
A short and sweet romance visual novel where you go to the laundromat and meet a boy that feels like a living ghost.

[From [url=https://doubledeadstudio.itch.io/lost-connections]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部温馨甜美的短篇恋爱视觉小说：你前往自助洗衣店，在那里邂逅了一位仿佛活生生的幽灵般的少年。

[摘自[url=https://doubledeadstudio.itch.io/lost-connections]itch.io[/url]]
